claims.claim: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle merges current config with cmd.Config and only skips entries where v == KeepSecretSentinel (__KEEP__), overwriting merged[k] = v for any other value (including *** or masked URIs) before calling h.writer.UpdateConfig(ctx, cmd.Name, merged).

In kafka_connect.go, UpdateConfig calls FilterSafeConfig(out.Config), which masks sensitive keys containing password/secret/token/credentials/ssl.key to "***" and sanitizes mongodb.connection.string and fs.uris.

In system_connectors_credentials.go, validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs checks if host == "" || user == "" || database == "" || pass == "" || pass == "***" and returns nil, but does not check pass == sourceCmd.KeepSecretSentinel ("__KEEP__"), so it builds a postgres DSN with pass and calls gorm.Open.
